questions.question: What is a common product when carbon-containing fuels undergo combustion?
options: Carbon dioxide
Pure hydrogen
Nitrogen gas
Helium

questions.question: Which of the following describes the chemical structure of a molecule of carbon dioxide?
options: One carbon atom and one oxygen atom
One carbon atom and two oxygen atoms
Two carbon atoms and one oxygen atom
Two carbon atoms and two oxygen atoms

questions.question: Approximately what percentage of Earth's atmosphere is made up of carbon dioxide?
Which of the following gases is classified as a greenhouse gas?
options: Nitrogen
Oxygen
Carbon dioxide
Argon

questions.question: What is the primary consequence of an excessive accumulation of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere?
options: A decrease in average global temperature
An increase in average global temperature, known as global warming
An increase in the concentration of atmospheric nitrogen
The complete depletion of the ozone layer

questions.question: Why is coal, a sedimentary rock, able to burn?
options: It is made mostly of carbon, with some impurities.
It contains high levels of trapped oxygen gas.
It is composed primarily of liquid petroleum.
It consists of radioactive elements that generate heat.

questions.question: Which of the following describes how coal originally formed?
options: From the cooling of molten volcanic lava under high pressure
From deep sediments of organic matter made of prehistoric plants
From the accumulation of mineral salts in shallow desert basins
From ancient meteorites that impacted Earth's crust

questions.question: What organic material originally formed oil and gas millions of years ago when mixed with sediments?
options: Prehistoric land trees
Dead plankton
Volcanic ash
Calcified dinosaur bones

questions.question: Where are oil and natural gas typically located within the Earth's crust?
options: In large hollow caverns of igneous rock
Inside the crystal structures of metamorphic rock
In the pores of sedimentary rock
Dissolved completely within magma chambers

questions.question: How does sedimentary rock form from buried and compressed sediment?
options: Magma cools down and crystallizes slowly over thousands of years
High heat and pressure recrystallize minerals without melting them
Salts from fluids cement the sediment grains together
Wind blows loose sand until it melts into solid glass sheets

questions.question: In which type of rock are fossils exclusively found?
options: Igneous rock
Metamorphic rock
Sedimentary rock
Volcanic rock

questions.question: What are the two major gases that make up 78% and 21% of Earth's atmosphere respectively?
options: Carbon dioxide and Oxygen
Nitrogen and Oxygen
Hydrogen and Nitrogen
Argon and Carbon dioxide

questions.question: What is the standard chemical test for identifying carbon dioxide gas?
options: It relights a glowing splint.
It turns blue cobalt chloride paper pink.
It squeaks when exposed to a lighted splint.
It forms a white precipitate that turns limewater milky.

questions.question: How does the process of combustion affect the Earth's atmosphere?
options: It decreases the amount of oxygen while having no effect on carbon dioxide.
It increases the amount of carbon dioxide.
It significantly reduces the amount of greenhouse gases.
It produces large amounts of ozone in the troposphere.

questions.question: Which process actively reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere?
options: Respiration by animals
Combustion of fossil fuels
Photosynthesis by plants and phytoplankton
Decomposition of dead organic matter
